title: Drug Shortage Early Warning
short: Combines demand, supplier and market signals to warn distributors before a medicine runs short.
symptom: Shortages are noticed only when orders fail
ingredient: An early-warning radar for the supply chain
directions: Connect sales, purchase orders and supplier lead times. Get a ranked list of products at risk, with the reason for each.
problem: Distributors and hospitals usually learn about a shortage when an order cannot be filled.
why: Shortages force therapeutic substitutions, raise costs and can harm patients.
solution: Tracks demand growth, supplier delivery delays, single-source products and stock across sites to score each product’s shortage risk and suggest options early.
limitations: Risk scores need validation against past shortages
data: Supplier delivery performance and lead times
review: Supply planners decide on alternatives and purchases; the system only ranks risk.
